finding: Clue gate: the obelisk picks one of 5 clue scenes at random per look (objects.py line 244), stores the pick on the viewer (line 254), and each tomb door checks equality with its own value (rooms.py line 1142); match goes to the treasure room, mismatch to the dark cell (build.ev lines 1041 and 1043).

One figure across five doors: five tomb murals of 1 to 5 source lines each show the same woman in different scenes; the last clue names the white-haired hero (build.ev 1030-1223); 22 dig lines in all, 16 numbered rooms.
Two-voice sign: an official warning title plus a rough carved second line that gives the real hint; a readable object with one text attribute (build.ev 260-285).

Naming and trait cards: EvAdventure chargen_tables has 10 trait slots of 20 entries each (virtue, vice, background, misfortune, speech and others), 4 band tables and 2 gear lists; a 282-entry given-name list of single capitalised words with no surnames (random_tables.py line 8).
Reaction bands: a 5-band table over rolls 2 to 12 (Hostile to Helpful) for first-contact attitude (random_tables.py lines 604-611); the roll method was not read.
Talking NPC: 5 menu nodes with 2 to 3 options each, and the info nodes loop back to each other; a demo, not a rumour system (talking_npc.py lines 32-80).
Ghost has two text states (long alive description, three-line dead howl); its defeat sends the player to the dark cell with a black-screen message (build.ev lines 832-858).

Licence: BSD-3 for code and contributions; Knave-derived tables credited as Creative Commons Attribution in the README (stated, not checked). Shape only for murals and clues; no tomb text or name list copied.
Faction ladder: nine grades from ally to scowls, each chosen by the first minimum reached; defaults in ruletypes.h lines 1065-1072 (shape only, GPL donor, values not copied).

Faction ripple: one reward gives the primary faction the full amount and up to 10 linked factions a multiplier times the amount; each linked change is truncated, floored at one point, and keeps its sign (client.cpp 9107-9169; 2022 seed has 371 rows).
Hate-list fan-out: every client on an NPC's hate list gets the same faction reward, not only the killer (hate_list.cpp 288-303).
Start standing by race, class and deity: faction_list_mod has 9801 rows over 556 factions and 49 keys (16 class, 16 race, 17 deity); mapping of keys to struct fields not read (2023 SQL).
Race kinship: hard-coded equal-race and indifferent-race groups (faction.cpp 91-165), with an in-code note that more values are to be added.

NPC emote lines: nine event types (combat start and end, death, after-death, hail, kills, spawn, despawn), chosen by (emote id, event), with tokens such as the NPC name and race (npc.cpp 2752-2795; 2142 emotes SQL).
Name cleaner: underscores become spaces, digits and punctuation are dropped, letters and backtick kept; cached per mob (strings_legacy.cpp 214-232; mob.cpp 5148).
Defect: a zero multiplier on a filled ripple slot still moves that faction by +1 (client.cpp 9156 and 9169; 2022 seed line 16). Fix: skip zero multipliers.
Check, not changed: a 341 multiplier on one ripple row (2022 seed line 98) is an outlier; a stray 1522 sits in an unused slot (harmless behind the id guard). Ask the data owner.
Defect: emote variety is dead under the shipped schema (random pick at npc.cpp 2767 against a unique key on emote id and event at 2142 line 8). Fix: key on a line id and keep the random pick.
Defect: the legacy threshold restore SQL has a misspelled kindly key (line 5) and missing row commas (lines 7 to 9), so it will not parse. Fix: correct both and keep the documented restore.

Narrative text absent from this tree: no quest scripts, NPC say-lines, zone story, sign or rumour text, and no emote rows; the ProjectEQ data named in the README is not present. The story-in-three-lines idea cannot be taken from this donor.
